Vera H: Quick QBR ask from CS leadership: build a 3-slide 'spend playbook' for three onboarding accounts (BlueMarble, Arcline, Solstice). Focus: runway snapshot, top spend drivers, and a compact mitigation plan. Volunteers?
Tom K: I'll take BlueMarble. What's the data window?
Vera H: Use last 30 days for trends, 7d for spikes. Add a simple "days until credits" calc at current burn and with a recommended throttle.
Sofia L: I'll own Arcline. I'll check for embed rebuilds and any batch jobs.
Jun P: Solstice for me. I'll do a QPS x seq sensitivity and a quick quantization ROI estimate.
Vera H: Also include a pre-approved pilot buffer: finance okayed one-off $3,000 for onboarding pilots if CS commits to a 10-day optimization run. Add that as an action item.
Tom K: For BlueMarble I already see lots of long-context dev calls. I'll propose a dev-route cap and a sampling layer.
Sofia L: Arcline has full daily embed reindexes — looks like 60% of their 7d spend. Recommend incremental + windowed sharding.
Jun P: Running a sim now. Command:
```
./bin/sim_spend --acct SOLSTICE --horizon 30 --qps 25,50,100 --lens 64,256,1024 --out solstice-sim.csv
```
Vera H: Good. Add a renewal-risk rule: mark "priority" if (MoM burn > 30% AND projected runout < 28 days). If flagged, CS should reach out within 48h and offer pilot.
Tom K: Data access: @OpsAccess can you grant read to tom.k@redwood for bluemarble-billing?
OpsAccess Bot: access granted to tom.k@redwood for project bluemarble-billing.
Sofia L: Drafting the enablement snippet now. Short and prescriptive:
"Hi <acct>, we observed a spend increase driven by nightly embed jobs/long-context calls. Quick wins: 1) cap dev contexts to 512 2) switch embeds to incremental 3) enable quantization for batch. We can apply a one-time $3k pilot if you accept a 10-day optimization plan. Reply OK to proceed"'
FinanceBot: note: pilot buffer $3,000 available for onboarding accounts; approval ID: FB-ONB-3000.
Jun P: Uploaded sim CSVs to drive: https://drive.redwood/qbr/solstice-sim.csv. Headline: 100qps@1024 -> ~$1.4k/day unoptimized; quantized ~30% lower. I'll attach a small sensitivity table.
Vera H: Owners recap: BlueMarble=Tom, Arcline=Sofia, Solstice=Jun, Enablement=Vera. Deliverables due Wed 3pm PT so I can assemble Thu morning. Dry-run Thu 9am PT. Flag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
